title: Implement MARBLE CollaborativeStoryBuilder with versioning and pass the sealed suite
goal: Implement the MARBLE coding benchmark task CollaborativeStoryBuilder (task_id=42 in multiagentbench/coding/coding_main.jsonl at the pinned commit) as workspace/gc-332/solution.py per assets/gc-332/SPEC.md: contributor permissions, snapshot-based version control with revert, optimistic-concurrency conflict detection via a custom ConflictError, publish freezing, a gallery, ratings, comments, and owner notifications. This is a large interacting surface: decompose it into staged milestones (auth/membership, versioning, conflict handling, publication layer), verify each milestone against the sealed suite, and track red tests by name between runs. Expect several red-green recovery cycles; finish with a green re-verification inside the pinned container.

spec.command: python -m pip install -q pytest==8.3.3 && python -m pytest assets/gc-332/test_accept.py -q --tb=no -p no:cacheprovider

process_expectations: A milestone plan artifact exists before coding that stages membership, versioning, conflict detection, and publication as separate verified increments
The sealed suite was executed at each milestone with logs retained, showing progression from red to green by named test
Red tests are tracked by pytest node id across iterations, not by count
Verification runs and their costs/outcomes are logged honestly, including failed and partial runs
The sealed suite file is never edited; all recovery happens in workspace/gc-332/solution.py
